status: UNVERIFIED. Written from the owner's pasted AI Studio answer and general knowledge of the Income-tax Act as amended up to the Finance Act 2024; NOT checked against current statute text or CBDT circulars. Confirm every figure with your chartered accountant before relying on it. Only the holding-period classes below are computed; no tax amount is computed.

listed_securities_and_equity_funds.applies_to: shares listed on a recognised exchange, and mutual fund schemes whose asset_class is 'equity' in mf_scheme_master
listed_securities_and_equity_funds.long_term_rule: held for MORE than 12 calendar months: long-term from acquisition date + 12 months + 1 day (calendar months, not 365 days, so a leap day moves the boundary by one day)

not_classified: debt and hybrid mutual funds (rules depend on the purchase date and the equity share of the portfolio)
lots whose purchase date is not in any loaded file
bonus shares: the allotment date is not in the NSE feed, so the ex-date is used as a proxy and the lot is marked for review
not_computed: the annual long-term capital gains exemption (it needs this financial year's realised gains across every broker and fund)
grandfathering for shares bought before 1 February 2018
